notes.title: Full game release date announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Operators!

First of all, we would like to thank everybody who has played our Prologue and especially those who have provided valuable feedback. We are paying a lot of attention and listening to your comments, in order to include as many improvements as possible in the full version.

So, the big news is that we are launching the game on MAY 21, 2020.... Yes, next week!!!

We are really excited and grateful for all the support from our community. Make no mistake that we are working as hard as can be in order to give you a great experience.

Thank you, thank you, thank you! And don't forget to wishlist the full game so you don't miss it ;)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/863460/Cyber_Ops/]Cyber Ops: Available May 21, 2020[/url]
